// CHAOS-5156: closes a gap codex round r1 on #2292 found (independently
// confirmed against real lizard 1.23.0 before fixing). stateDecToImp was
// missing the "const"/"&"/"&&" no-op branch clikeStates.stateDecToImp
// has (clike.go) -- Java has no C++11 ref-qualified member functions,
// but JavaStates inherits _state_dec_to_imp UNCHANGED (confirmed from
// source: no override exists), so lizard's tolerant tokenizer still
// parses this token shape. Covers both the "&" and "&&" ref-qualifier
// forms in one fixture. Measured directly against real lizard 1.23.0:
// complexity 2 each (base 1 + if).
class C {
    int f() & {
        if (x > 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    int g() && {
        if (x > 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
}
